title.narrative: Climate-Smart Agriculture and Market Development for Enhancing Livelihoods of Refugees and their Host Communities in Rwanda- Phase I

description.narrative: The objective(s) of the development cooperation among the parties is to improve the food security and self-reliance of 728 refugee and 1,155 host community households (over 7,500 individuals) through climate-smart agricultural practices and market development approach in Rwanda.
